en: I knew you would come. I saw it three years ago, in a vision: a Champion from Johto, standing where you stand now.
I don't enjoy battling, but it's my duty as a Gym Leader. Show me the strength my vision promised!
Your power is far beyond what I foresaw. Even my visions can't see everything. Take the Marsh Badge.
{player} received the Marsh Badge from Sabrina!
Take this as well. It holds a move that lets two Pokémon trade their abilities.
TM48 is Skill Swap. Used well, it turns a foe's own ability against it.
Psychic power isn't only for battling. I've learned to feel what others feel, too. You feel... happy.
Hey, champ! Sabrina waits in the middle room, but the only way in is by the warp panels.
Step on one and it whisks you to another room. Keep trying them, and you'll find the way through!
Her Pokémon are Psychic types. Dark types and Bug types are what you want here.
You read Sabrina's mind before she could read yours! What a battle!

Saffron City Pokémon Gym
Leader: Sabrina
